```json
{
  "searchQueries": [
    "butter cutting ASMR",
    "butter slice satisfying sound",
    "ASMR food cutting knife"
  ],
  "source": "local BubbleSheet = {}
BubbleSheet.__index = BubbleSheet

function BubbleSheet.new(sheet)
	assert(sheet and sheet:IsA("Model"), "sheet must be a Model")

	local self = setmetatable({}, BubbleSheet)
	self._sheet = sheet
	self._count = 0
	self._total = 0
	self._destroyed = false
	self._generation = 0
	self._pending = {}
	self._popped = {}
	self._originals = {}
	self._connections = {}

	for _, part in sheet:GetChildren() do
		if part:IsA("BasePart") then
			self._total += 1
			local cd = part:FindFirstChildOfClass("ClickDetector")
			local mesh = part:FindFirstChildOfClass("SpecialMesh")

			self._originals[part] = {
				Transparency = part.Transparency,
				MaxActivationDistance = cd and cd.MaxActivationDistance or 0,
				MeshScale = mesh and mesh.Scale:Clone() or Vector3.new(1, 1, 1),
			}

			if cd then
				local conn = cd.MouseClick:Connect(function()
					self:Press(part)
				end)
				table.insert(self._connections, conn)
			end
		end
	end

	return self
end

function BubbleSheet:Press(part)
	if self._destroyed then return false end
	if not part or not self._originals[part] then return false end
	if self._pending[part] or self._popped[part] then return false end

	self._pending[part] = true
	local gen = self._generation
	local orig = self._originals[part]

	task.spawn(function()
		local mesh = part:FindFirstChildOfClass("SpecialMesh")
		local duration = 0.12
		local elapsed = 0

		while elapsed < duration do
			if self._generation ~= gen then return end
			local dt = task.wait()
			elapsed += dt
			local t = math.min(elapsed / duration, 1)
			if mesh then
				mesh.Scale = orig.MeshScale * (1 - 0.3 * t)
			end
		end

		if self._generation ~= gen then return end

		local sound = part:FindFirstChildOfClass("Sound")
		if sound then sound:Play() end
		part.Transparency = 1

		local cd = part:FindFirstChildOfClass("ClickDetector")
		if cd then cd.MaxActivationDistance = 0 end

		if mesh then mesh.Scale = orig.MeshScale end

		self._count += 1
		self._pending[part] = nil
		self._popped[part] = true
	end)

	return true
end

function BubbleSheet:Reset()
	self._generation += 1
	self._count = 0
	table.clear(self._pending)
	table.clear(self._popped)

	for part, orig in self._originals do
		part.Transparency = orig.Transparency
		local cd = part:FindFirstChildOfClass("ClickDetector")
		if cd then cd.MaxActivationDistance = orig.MaxActivationDistance end
		local mesh = part:FindFirstChildOfClass("SpecialMesh")
		if mesh then mesh.Scale = orig.MeshScale end
	end
end

function BubbleSheet:Destroy()
	self._generation += 1
	self._destroyed = true
	table.clear(self._pending)

	for _, conn in self._connections do
		conn:Disconnect()
	end
	table.clear(self._connections)
end

function BubbleSheet:GetCount()
	return self._count
end

function BubbleSheet:IsComplete()
	return self._count >= self._total
end

return BubbleSheet",
  "defects": [
    "task.delay callback is not cancelled on reset: pending closures still fire after reset, setting Transparency=1 and incrementing count, corrupting the reset state.",
    "Reset hardcodes Transparency=0 instead of restoring each part's original transparency value, breaking parts that started semi-transparent.",
    "ClickDetector.MaxActivationDistance is never set to 0 on pop nor restored on reset, so the original disable-on-click behavior is lost and parts remain detectable after popping.",
    "No Click sound is played at the moment of pop, omitting required audio feedback.",
    "No visible depression animation occurs during the 0.12 s delay; the bubble is static until it abruptly disappears."
  ]
}
```
